BiblicalUsage: Isaac digs the well and names it Shebah, oath, because of the oath he and Abimelech swore there, and the city keeps the name Beersheba to this day. One verse carries the whole naming, and the well is still the witness of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a well named for an oath is the right kind of monument, because water and promise are the two things a man in the desert cannot live without.
